proposal.thesis: Chevron is breaking out near its 52-week high on a pocket-pivot volume read with a fresh bullish MACD cross while Brent/WTI remain elevated (CL=F ~$94). Q2 2026 printed adjusted EPS $6.06, record U.S. production, record U.S. refinery crude throughput (1.07 mbpd, 97% utilization), ROCE 21%, and FCF $18.1B in the quarter, with $3B structural cost savings and $1.5B acquisition synergies already banked. UBS raised its target to $235 and Q3 EPS to $4.93 on stronger refining margins and crude realizations ahead of the 2026-10-30 print. This is a half-risk starter at the watchlist $218 level on a full in-session slot with a fresh live overlay; the energy demand_driver diversifies a book that is otherwise software/healthcare/storage tilted (portfolio beta 0.62).
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: Street frames CVX as a late-cycle oil major with a cautious Q3 setup (some houses flag storm downtime and a possible EPS miss vs ~$4.70 consensus) and treats the stock as fairly valued near high-$200s with UBS at $235. MY VIEW: The breakout-plus-pocket-pivot at the highs with oil still firm is the market starting to price the integrated cash-engine and synergy delivery, not a one-quarter miss. MECHANISM: Consensus models underweight refining strength and the already-captured cost/synergy run-rate while overweighting temporary Gulf of Mexico downtime; cash return capacity (debt cut $8.4B in Q2, ongoing buybacks) supports the multiple if oil holds. RESOLUTION: The 2026-10-30 Q3 print and call - if adjusted EPS clears ~$4.70 and upstream volumes/refining margins confirm, the tape should re-rate; we exit before the print if structure fails.
proposal.risk_map: Thesis dies on a daily close back under $208 (failed breakout), a sharp oil break (CL=F sustained under ~$80), or a Q3 guide that cuts volumes/margins enough to unwind the cash-return story. Early tell: loss of the 50-DMA on rising volume while SPY holds.
catalysts: 2026-10-30 Q3 earnings (exit or trim before if structure softens)
Synergy and structural cost run-rate confirmation on the call
proposal.macro_context: Regime supportive (SPY above 50/200-DMA, VIX ~15.5, momentum healthy, universe A/D 0.85). Oil elevated on geopolitical supply risk; rates/HY spreads are a headwind but not a hostile tape. Energy is a diversifier vs the book's AI/software tilt.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: A 2026-10-30 Q3 print or guide that cuts production outlook or shows refining margins collapsing enough to force consensus FY26/FY27 EPS cuts of more than 5%.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $208 on rising volume, giving back the breakout shelf while SPY remains above its 200-DMA (stock-specific failure).
thesis_invalidators.time_box: Exit by the 2026-10-29 close in every case so we are not holding through the 2026-10-30 binary; if CVX has not held a daily close above $225 by 2026-10-24, cut or exit.
